columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.selectedTitle: HITL resumption needs trusted session initialization and confirmation boundaries
columns.selectedTitle_zh: HITL 恢复需要可信的会话初始化与确认边界
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260815-010 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It is the strongest bounded Digital Employee object in the run-date pool because it joins two runtime-authority boundaries in one concrete mechanism: client-supplied initialization events are prevented from seeding trusted session state, while HITL confirmation handling is tightened during resume. That yields a specific research question about which state may be admitted before a digital employee resumes after human intervention and how confirmation evidence is bound to the resumed execution. Guardian v2 policy-driven risk classification and explicit memory identity/topic controls are both strong candidates, but they are broader policy or memory-scope mechanisms rather than a direct resume-integrity boundary.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260815-010，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它是运行日信号池中最强的有界数字员工对象，因为在一个具体机制中连接了两个运行时授权边界：客户端提供的初始化事件不能直接注入可信会话状态，同时 HITL 恢复时的确认处理被收紧。这形成一个明确研究问题：数字员工在人类介入后恢复执行之前，哪些状态可以被接纳，以及确认依据如何绑定到恢复后的执行。Guardian v2 的策略化风险分类和显式记忆身份/主题控制同样很强，但它们分别偏向更宽的策略或记忆作用域问题，不如该对象直接聚焦恢复完整性边界。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.selectedTitle: Native A2A task execution needs explicit delegation scope, finish semantics, and terminal-state mapping
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 原生 A2A Task 执行需要显式委派作用域、完成语义与终态映射
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260815-008 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It exposes a bounded inter-agent execution architecture rather than only an instruction-distribution mechanism: RemoteA2aAgent gains native task mode, finish-task registration, delegation-scope aggregation and terminal-state mapping inside the A2A executor. The object therefore supports a concrete architecture question about how delegated work becomes a governed task with explicit completion and terminal semantics across an agent boundary. The model-catalog role-instruction signal remains a useful candidate, but it is primarily configuration/role distribution and has less execution-state depth than native A2A task mode.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260815-008，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它暴露的是有界的 Agent 间执行架构，而不仅是指令分发机制：RemoteA2aAgent 获得原生 Task 模式、finish-task 注册、委派作用域聚合以及 A2A 执行器内的终态映射。因此可以形成具体架构问题：被委派的工作如何跨 Agent 边界成为具有显式完成语义和终态语义的受治理任务。模型目录角色指令信号仍是有价值候选，但它主要属于配置/角色分发，执行状态深度弱于原生 A2A Task 模式。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.selectedTitle: Agent runtimes must own background tool-task cancellation at run teardown
columns.selectedTitle_zh: Agent Runtime 必须在运行收尾时负责后台工具任务的取消
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260815-009 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It is the strongest bounded Open-source Engineering object because it defines ownership of streaming and non-blocking background tool tasks at handoff or teardown, explicitly cancels them, and releases stale stream-registry entries instead of allowing orphaned work to outlive the run. The mechanism is concrete, failure-oriented and regression-testable, giving a focused engineering question about lifecycle ownership and cleanup boundaries in agent runtimes. Executor network-policy auditing and environment-configuration ownership are both strong candidates, but neither exposes as direct a resource-lifetime failure mode.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260815-009，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它是开源工程栏目中最强的有界对象，因为它明确了交接或运行收尾时对流式与非阻塞后台工具任务的所有权：这些任务会被显式取消，同时释放陈旧的流注册项，而不是让孤儿工作继续超出本次 Run 生命周期。该机制具体、面向失败场景且可回归测试，形成一个聚焦的工程问题：Agent Runtime 如何定义资源生命周期所有权与清理边界。执行器网络策略审计和环境配置所有权同样是强候选，但都没有暴露如此直接的资源生命周期失败模型。

signals.observedChange: The runtime fix prevents already-resolved approval state from being incorrectly re-evaluated by later policy checks.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该修复避免已解决的审批状态被后续策略检查错误地重新判定。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents Python defers non-stream session persistence until output guardrails finish
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents Python 将非流式会话持久化延后至输出门禁完成
signals.observedChange: Non-stream session state is no longer saved before output guardrails complete, aligning durable state with the governed outcome.
signals.observedChange_zh: 非流式会话状态不再于输出门禁结束前保存，使持久状态与受治理结果保持一致。

signals.title: Codex adds durable per-thread user submission queues

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.222 hardens worktree isolation and background-task permission enforcement
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.222 强化工作树隔离与后台任务权限执行
signals.observedChange: The release blocks destructive Git actions against the main checkout from isolated sessions, extends isolation to edits and Bash, and closes a background PreToolUse bypass.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该版本阻止隔离会话对主检出执行破坏性 Git 操作，将隔离扩展至编辑与 Bash，并修复后台 PreToolUse 绕过。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.78 expands worktree, permission, sandbox, managed-policy, and session controls
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.78 扩展工作树、权限、沙箱、托管策略与会话控制
signals.observedChange: The release adds a new-worktree flow, approval-mode switching, session-only sandbox bypass, managed-settings refresh, rewind, MCP refresh after OAuth, and faster long-session resume.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该版本新增新工作树流程、审批模式切换、仅会话级沙箱绕过、托管设置刷新、回退、OAuth 后 MCP 刷新及长会话快速恢复。

signals.title: OpenAI audit estimates roughly 30% of SWE-Bench Pro tasks are broken
signals.title_zh: OpenAI 审计估计 SWE-Bench Pro 约 30% 任务存在缺陷
signals.observedChange: OpenAI combined automated filtering, investigator agents, and expert annotation, then retracted its earlier recommendation to adopt SWE-Bench Pro.

signals.title: AgentLens evaluates complete coding-agent trajectories rather than pass/fail alone

signals.observedChange: The benchmark combines formal verification, trajectory reviews, and side-by-side comparisons to diagnose behavior and detect regressions.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该基准结合形式验证、轨迹审查与并排比较，用于诊断行为并发现回归。

signals.title: Microsoft Universal Verifier separates process, outcome, and controllable failure for computer-use agents

signals.observedChange: The work reports human-level agreement, near-zero false positives relative to prior baselines, process/outcome separation, and controllable/uncontrollable failure scoring.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该研究报告了接近人类一致性的判断、相较既有基线近乎为零的误报，以及过程/结果和可控/不可控失败分离。

columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.selectedTitle: Revisable DAG orchestration for multi-agent computer-use Digital Employees
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 面向计算机操作型数字员工的可修订 DAG 多 Agent 编排
columns.reason: This is the strongest bounded Digital Employee object in the pool: it directly studies manager-worker decomposition, parallel computer-use execution, dynamic replanning and measured wall-clock effects using primary research rather than a product announcement.
columns.reason_zh: 这是信号池中边界最清晰的数字员工对象：它以主要研究直接讨论管理者—执行者拆解、并行计算机操作、动态图修订及墙钟时间测量，而非普通产品公告。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the task decomposition algorithm, DAG revision rules, worker coordination, benchmark design, reported gains, failure cases and limits of transferring the method into governed Digital Employee runtimes.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查任务拆解算法、DAG 修订规则、执行者协调、基准设计、报告收益、失败案例及迁移到受治理数字员工运行时的边界。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.selectedTitle: Managed policy, sandbox and resume boundaries in enterprise coding-agent runtimes
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 企业编码 Agent 运行时的托管策略、沙箱与恢复边界
columns.reason: The release concentrates several enterprise architecture controls in one authoritative object: policy distribution, permission enforcement, sandbox containment, fallback observability and resume recovery. The combination is more valuable than treating each fix as isolated product news.
columns.reason_zh: 该官方发布在一个权威对象中集中呈现多项企业架构控制：策略分发、权限强制、沙箱隔离、回退可观测性与恢复治理；其组合价值高于把各项修复视为零散产品新闻。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the exact managed-policy surface, precedence and enforcement points, sandbox escape fixes, fallback disclosure, resume failure modes and what remains undocumented.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查托管策略表面、优先级与执行点、沙箱逃逸修复、回退披露、恢复失败模式及仍未公开的边界。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.selectedTitle: Atomic legacy rollout migration with semantic replay and recoverable journaling
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 基于语义重放、原子发布与可恢复日志的旧版 Rollout 迁移
columns.reason: The maintainer change exposes a reproducible migration-and-recovery design with strong engineering boundaries: semantic preservation, active-writer exclusion, dry-run, idempotency, journaled recovery and atomic replacement. It directly informs durable agent-runtime history evolution.
columns.reason_zh: 该维护者变更给出可复现且边界清晰的迁移恢复设计：语义保持、活跃写入者排除、dry-run、幂等、日志恢复与原子替换，可直接支撑 Agent 运行时历史存储演进。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the commit series, migration state machine, journal format, recovery tests, active-writer detection, atomic replacement and compatibility limits.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查提交链、迁移状态机、日志格式、恢复测试、活跃写入者检测、原子替换及兼容性限制。

signals.title: Claude Code v2.1.223 hardens managed policy, permission checks, workflow sandboxing and resume behavior
signals.title_zh: Claude Code v2.1.223 加强托管策略、权限检查、工作流沙箱与恢复行为
signals.observedChange: The release adds organization-wide marketplace allow/block wildcards, warns when restricted subagent models fall back to the parent model, fixes command-obfuscation permission bypasses and workflow-sandbox escape paths, enforces organization bypass-permission policy, and repairs several resumed-session failure modes.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该版本新增组织级 Marketplace 通配允许/阻止规则，在受限子 Agent 模型回退到父模型时给出警告，修复命令混淆权限绕过与工作流沙箱逃逸路径，执行组织级绕过权限禁用策略，并修复多项会话恢复失败。

signals.title: Codex migrates legacy rollouts with semantic replay, atomic publication, journaling and recovery
signals.title_zh: Codex 以语义重放、原子发布、日志与恢复迁移旧版 Rollout
signals.observedChange: Linked maintainer changes migrate legacy JSONL rollouts into paginated history while preserving rollback, compaction and subagent-history semantics; replacements are atomic, migrations are journaled and recoverable, dry-run and idempotency are tested, and active writers are skipped.
signals.observedChange_zh: 关联维护者变更将旧版 JSONL Rollout 迁移到分页历史，同时保留回滚、压缩与子 Agent 历史语义；替换采用原子发布，迁移带日志并可恢复，覆盖 dry-run 与幂等测试，并跳过活跃写入者。

signals.title: Codex persists multi-agent usage hints in world state and refreshes them on resume
signals.title_zh: Codex 将多 Agent 使用提示持久化到 World State 并在恢复时刷新
signals.observedChange: Multi-agent usage instructions are now represented in world state and re-emitted when configuration or tool availability changes, including cold resumes and wait-agent guidance.
signals.observedChange_zh: 多 Agent 使用说明被纳入 World State，并在配置或工具可用性变化时重新发出，覆盖冷恢复及 wait-agent 引导。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents Python preserves completed guardrail evidence across resumed interruptions and streamed failure paths
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents Python 在恢复中断与流式失败路径中保留已完成门禁证据
signals.observedChange: Linked fixes keep completed tool-guardrail results when a resumed run interrupts again and publish completed streamed guardrail results on failure paths, preventing verified evidence from disappearing during non-success terminal flows.
signals.observedChange_zh: 关联修复在恢复后的运行再次中断时保留已完成的工具门禁结果，并在流式失败路径发布已完成门禁结果，避免已验证证据在非成功终结路径中消失。

signals.title: Google ADK fixes resume semantics so a paused child does not end its parent agent
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 修复恢复语义，避免暂停的子 Agent 终结父 Agent
signals.observedChange: The LlmAgent resume path no longer terminates the parent when a child pauses, clarifying propagation rules between local pause state and compound-agent lifecycle completion.
signals.observedChange_zh: LlmAgent 恢复路径不再因子 Agent 暂停而终结父 Agent，明确了局部暂停状态与复合 Agent 生命周期完成之间的传播规则。

signals.title: Gemini CLI preserves function-call thought signatures when filtering thought parts
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在过滤思考片段时保留函数调用 Thought Signature
signals.observedChange: The runtime now preserves functionCall thoughtSignature metadata while stripping thought parts, protecting tool-call continuity and history integrity across model transformations.
signals.observedChange_zh: 运行时在剥离思考片段时保留 functionCall 的 thoughtSignature 元数据，以维护模型转换过程中的工具调用连续性与历史完整性。

signals.title: Codex bounds remote MCP handshake HTTP requests to the initialization deadline
signals.title_zh: Codex 将远程 MCP 握手 HTTP 请求限制在初始化截止时间内
signals.observedChange: Streamable HTTP MCP initialize, initialized-notification and discovery requests now inherit the remaining handshake deadline, preventing a timed-out request from continuing to block the serial executor.
signals.observedChange_zh: Streamable HTTP MCP 的 initialize、initialized 通知与发现请求现在继承剩余握手截止时间，防止已超时请求继续阻塞串行执行器。

signals.title: Software Delegation Contracts measure reviewability gains rather than correctness gains
signals.title_zh: 软件委托契约测得的是可审阅性提升，而非正确率提升
signals.observedChange: A 64-run controlled pilot reports that explicit delegation contracts and required evidence bundles improved evidence sufficiency and reduced reviewer ambiguity without improving already-saturated hidden-test outcomes; the contracts increased token and wall-clock cost.
signals.observedChange_zh: 一项 64 次运行的受控试验报告称，显式委托契约与强制证据包提高了证据充分性并降低审阅歧义，但未提升已饱和的隐藏测试结果，同时增加了 Token 与墙钟时间成本。

signals.title: Multi-Agent Computer Use uses a revisable DAG manager for parallel long-horizon execution
signals.title_zh: Multi-Agent Computer Use 使用可修订 DAG 管理器执行并行长任务
signals.observedChange: A manager decomposes tasks into a dependency DAG, dispatches ready nodes in parallel and revises the graph as findings arrive; the paper reports 3.4–25.5% gains over single-agent baselines and about 1.5× wall-clock improvement on Odysseys.
signals.observedChange_zh: 管理器将任务分解为依赖 DAG，并行派发就绪节点，随新发现持续修订图；论文报告相对单 Agent 基线提升 3.4–25.5%，在 Odysseys 上墙钟时间约提升 1.5 倍。

signals.title: EvalAgent encodes evaluation expertise as reusable skills and executable trace-based artifacts
signals.title_zh: EvalAgent 将评估专业知识编码为可复用 Skill 与可执行轨迹评估产物
signals.observedChange: The study reports that generic coding assistants achieved only 30% execution success for evaluation generation, while an evaluation-skill pipeline improved Eval@1 from 17.5% to 65% and received 79.5% expert preference; ablation reduced Eval@1 to 30%.
signals.observedChange_zh: 研究报告称，通用编码助手生成评估时仅有 30% 执行成功率，而基于评估 Skill 的流水线将 Eval@1 从 17.5% 提升至 65%，获得 79.5% 专家偏好；移除 Skill 后 Eval@1 降至 30%。

signals.observedChange: The v0.54.0 release includes session-ID rotation on model fallback, HTTPS enforcement for Google credential transport, history filtering corrections and other runtime fixes accumulated since the prior stable line.

signals.observedChange: Active subagent threads now clear configured MCP startup expectations so visible startup state is driven by actual notifications; primary threads and side conversations retain configured-server tracking.

signals.observedChange_zh: 恢复运行现在对从 RunState 接管的可变列表使用副本，而不再共享原列表对象，从而强化持久化恢复状态与后续执行变更之间的隔离。

signals.title: Google ADK bounds both entry count and bytes read from uploaded skill ZIP archives

signals.observedChange: Skill archive ingestion now enforces bounds on archive entry count and bytes read, reducing resource-exhaustion exposure at the skill package boundary.

signals.title_zh: Google ADK 从 Session Service 错误与日志中脱敏数据库密码
signals.observedChange: Session service failure handling now redacts database passwords from errors and log output, strengthening observability without leaking connection secrets.
signals.observedChange_zh: Session Service 失败处理现在从错误与日志输出中脱敏数据库密码，在保持可观测性的同时避免泄露连接秘密。

signals.title: A2A corrects its v1 migration guide to match normative ProtoJSON stream names and serializable fields

signals.title: OneDayAgent proposes a long-horizon harness with bounded subtasks, execution memory and final-deliverable verification and repair
signals.title_zh: OneDayAgent 提出包含有界子任务、执行记忆与最终交付验证修复的长周期 Harness
signals.observedChange: The paper presents a backend-agnostic long-horizon harness that manages goal and state persistence, context pressure, bounded subtask decomposition, and final deliverable verification across 104 AgentIF-OneDay tasks.
signals.observedChange_zh: 论文提出面向多 Backend 的长周期 Harness，联合管理目标与状态持久化、上下文压力、有界子任务拆解及最终交付验证，并在 104 个 AgentIF-OneDay 任务上评估。

signals.title: Argus describes a durable role-owned runtime with verification-gated self-evolution and operator escalation points
signals.title_zh: Argus 描述具有角色所有权、验证门禁自演化与操作员升级点的持久运行时
signals.observedChange: Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives and lets Manager, Planner, Engineer and Reviewer operate bounded missions over durable state; memories, skills and routing decisions are admitted only after role-owned review and available task-native verification.
signals.observedChange_zh: Argus 将稳定用户意图与操作目标分离，由 Manager、Planner、Engineer、Reviewer 在持久状态上执行有界 Mission；Memory、Skill 与路由决策仅在角色 Review 及可用任务原生验证后进入持久运行时。

signals.title: A Microsoft Azure production study characterizes agentic workflows as fragmented CPU-GPU orchestration with role-sensitive resource demand
signals.title_zh: Microsoft Azure 生产研究将 Agentic Workflow 刻画为碎片化 CPU-GPU 编排与角色敏感资源需求
signals.observedChange: The study combines Microsoft Azure production traces with controlled open-source framework experiments to characterize tool and orchestration fragmentation, bursty CPU demand, GPU multiplexing and role-aware scheduling implications.
signals.observedChange_zh: 研究结合 Microsoft Azure 生产 Trace 与开源框架受控实验，刻画工具与编排碎片化、突发 CPU 需求、GPU 多路复用及角色感知调度的架构影响。

signals.title: Active-SWE benchmarks coding agents on proactive multi-bug discovery and repair without issue-report guidance
signals.title_zh: Active-SWE 在没有 Issue Report 指引时评测 Coding Agent 主动发现并修复多 Bug 的能力
signals.observedChange: Active-SWE expands coding-agent evaluation beyond reactive issue-driven repair to 1,663 proactive bug-fixing tasks across six bug categories and eight languages, using a difficulty-aware construction pipeline and dual-track evaluation.
signals.observedChange_zh: Active-SWE 将 Coding Agent 评测从依赖 Issue 的被动修复扩展到 1,663 个主动 Bug 修复任务，覆盖 6 类 Bug 与 8 种语言，并使用难度感知构造与双轨评测。

signals.title_zh: ChatGPT Voice 新增文件上传与 Projects 上下文
signals.observedChange: OpenAI says GPT-Live in ChatGPT Voice now supports file uploads and Projects, allowing voice conversations to analyze uploaded files and reference recent project chats, sources, and project instructions.
signals.observedChange_zh: OpenAI 表示 ChatGPT Voice 中的 GPT-Live 现支持文件上传与 Projects，可在语音会话中分析上传文件，并引用近期项目对话、来源和项目指令。

signals.title: Claude Managed Agents adds hard session budgets with pause-and-resume semantics
signals.title_zh: Claude Managed Agents 新增具有暂停与恢复语义的 Session 硬预算
signals.observedChange: Anthropic added session budgets to Claude Managed Agents. The budget is a hard spend cap; a session pauses with budget_reached instead of starting new model requests, and changing or removing the budget resumes it. Deployments can apply the same budget to each session they start.
signals.observedChange_zh: Anthropic 为 Claude Managed Agents 增加 Session 预算。预算作为硬性支出上限；达到预算时 Session 以 budget_reached 原因暂停，不再发起新模型请求；修改或移除预算后可恢复。Deployment 也可将同一预算应用到其启动的每个 Session。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot usage metrics API separates third-party agent app activity by stable agent ID
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot Usage Metrics API 按稳定 Agent ID 分离第三方 Agent App 活动
signals.observedChange: GitHub added totals_by_3rd_party_agent to Copilot usage metrics. Recognized agent apps are reported by stable agent_id with user-initiated job starts and, for aggregate reports, session counts, enabling separate adoption measurement for agents such as Claude and Codex.
signals.observedChange_zh: GitHub 在 Copilot Usage Metrics 中新增 totals_by_3rd_party_agent。可识别的 Agent App 以稳定 agent_id 统计用户发起的 Job 启动次数，并在聚合报表中统计 Session 数，使 Claude、Codex 等不同 Agent 的采用情况可以被分别度量。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot code review effort levels become GA with organization defaults and visible execution labels
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot Code Review Effort Level GA，并支持组织默认值与可见执行标签
signals.observedChange: GitHub made Lite and Balanced Copilot code-review effort levels generally available, added organization-wide defaults inherited by repositories, and records the effort level used in timeline events and pull-request overview comments.
signals.observedChange_zh: GitHub 将 Copilot Code Review 的 Lite 与 Balanced Effort Level 推向 GA，新增可由仓库继承的组织级默认值，并在 Timeline Event 与 PR Overview Comment 中记录实际使用的 Effort Level。

signals.title: Codex can require automatic review for centrally managed model slugs
signals.title_zh: Codex 可对集中管理的模型 Slug 强制自动 Review
signals.observedChange: Codex added auto_review.required_on_models, forces listed models to on-request approvals with the auto_review reviewer, downgrades Full Access to workspace-write for protected sessions, rejects incompatible overrides, and preserves the requirement across thread lifecycle and MCP approval paths.
signals.observedChange_zh: Codex 新增 auto_review.required_on_models，对指定模型强制使用 on-request Approval 与 auto_review Reviewer；受保护 Session 的 Full Access 会降为 workspace-write，不兼容 Override 会被拒绝，并在 Thread 生命周期与 MCP Approval 路径中持续保持该要求。

signals.title: Codex disables reusable command-approval rules for cyber-specialized models
signals.title_zh: Codex 对 Cyber 专用模型禁用可复用命令 Approval 规则
signals.observedChange: Codex now filters saved allow-prefix rules for cyber-specialized models and models listed in auto_review.ignore_rules while preserving restrictive policy entries, limiting command approvals for those models to one-time decisions across execution backends.
signals.observedChange_zh: Codex 现在会为 Cyber 专用模型及 auto_review.ignore_rules 中的模型过滤已保存的 Allow Prefix 规则，同时保留限制性策略条目，使这些模型在各执行后端的命令 Approval 仅能作为一次性决定。

signals.title: Codex Guardian review sessions can reuse parent compactions after history rewrites
signals.title_zh: Codex Guardian Review Session 可在父历史重写后复用 Parent Compaction
signals.observedChange: An under-development Codex feature restarts Guardian review sessions after parent history rewrites and seeds them with the latest reusable encrypted compaction; when no reusable compaction exists, the current reviewer is retained to preserve authorization and restriction context.
signals.observedChange_zh: Codex 的开发中功能会在父历史重写后重启 Guardian Review Session，并注入最新可复用的加密 Compaction；当不存在可复用 Compaction 时则保留当前 Reviewer，以维持授权与限制上下文。

signals.title: Codex defines a versioned gRPC host protocol for code-mode sessions and executions
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 Code Mode Session 与执行定义版本化 gRPC Host Protocol
signals.observedChange: Codex introduced the codex.code_mode.v1 protobuf API for code-mode session management, executions, waits, tool callbacks, notifications and content results, plus generated Rust client/server bindings and Bazel protobuf targets.
signals.observedChange_zh: Codex 新增 codex.code_mode.v1 Protobuf API，用于 Code Mode 的 Session 管理、执行、等待、Tool Callback、通知与内容结果，并生成 Rust Client/Server Binding 与 Bazel Protobuf Target。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents Python hardens sandbox artifact fidelity for lazy skills and workspace extraction
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents Python 加固 Lazy Skill 与 Workspace 解包的 Sandbox 工件保真度
signals.observedChange: Two adjacent sandbox fixes preserve source-entry metadata when lazily loading a skill and restore archived file modes when extracting a workspace tar, reducing divergence between materialized sandbox state and its source artifact.
signals.observedChange_zh: 相邻两项 Sandbox 修复分别在 Lazy Load Skill 时保留 Source Entry Metadata，并在解包 Workspace Tar 时恢复归档文件 Mode，从而降低实体化 Sandbox 状态与源工件之间的偏差。

signals.title: Gemini CLI Caretaker clears execution locks when work transitions to NEEDS_HUMAN
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI Caretaker 在工作进入 NEEDS_HUMAN 时清理执行锁
signals.observedChange: The Caretaker agent workflow now clears its lock on a NEEDS_HUMAN transition, explicitly settling execution ownership when automation escalates to a human instead of leaving a stale lock behind.
signals.observedChange_zh: Caretaker Agent Workflow 现在会在进入 NEEDS_HUMAN 状态时清除 Lock，明确在自动化升级给人工时结算执行所有权，避免遗留 Stale Lock。

signals.title: Google ADK blocks the Python standard library from agent-config code references
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 阻止 Agent Config Code Reference 访问 Python 标准库
signals.observedChange: ADK replaced an incomplete module-by-module denylist with sys.stdlib_module_names for YAML code references after identifying standard-library modules capable of executing supplied strings; the change narrows arbitrary-code exposure but explicitly does not cover third-party packages.
signals.observedChange_zh: ADK 在发现多个可执行传入字符串的标准库模块未被旧 Denylist 覆盖后，使用 sys.stdlib_module_names 阻止 YAML Code Reference 访问整个标准库。该改动缩小任意代码执行面，但明确不覆盖第三方包。

signals.title: Google ADK stops sharing GCS clients across credentials
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 停止跨 Credential 共享 GCS Client
signals.observedChange: ADK changed its tool integration so Google Cloud Storage clients are not shared across different credentials, tightening credential-scoped client isolation in agent tool execution.
signals.observedChange_zh: ADK 修改工具集成，使 Google Cloud Storage Client 不再跨不同 Credential 共享，从而收紧 Agent 工具执行中的 Credential Scope Client 隔离。

signals.title: OrchestraBench evaluates multi-agent orchestration failure modes, recovery, and decomposition quality
signals.title_zh: OrchestraBench 评估多 Agent 编排故障模式、恢复与任务分解质量
signals.observedChange: The paper introduces a seed-reproducible failure-injection harness for enterprise-style multi-agent workflows, cascade-radius and per-failure recovery metrics, and reports that blind retry can reproduce latent faults while trusted-state signals materially improve containment.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该论文提出面向企业式多 Agent Workflow 的可复现故障注入 Harness、Cascade Radius 与按故障类型恢复指标，并报告 Blind Retry 会重复潜在故障，而 Trusted-State Signal 对故障收敛具有实质影响。

signals.title: Activity Frames compiles screen activity into deterministic, auditable agent memory and replay
signals.title_zh: Activity Frames 将屏幕活动编译为确定性、可审计的 Agent Memory 与 Replay
signals.observedChange: The preprint proposes a zero-model deterministic compiler that converts passive screen capture into typed activity frames with evidence pointers. On a single-user 51-day corpus it reports 86x compression and 98.4% question-answer accuracy, while also demonstrating a guard-matched replay with zero model tokens.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该预印本提出零模型、确定性的编译器，将被动屏幕捕获转换为带 Evidence Pointer 的 Typed Activity Frame。在单用户 51 天语料上报告 86 倍压缩与 98.4% 问答准确率，并展示 Guard Match 命中时零模型 Token 的确定性 Replay。

signals.title: CodeGrep trains a dedicated retrieval agent to reduce coding-agent search cost
signals.title_zh: CodeGrep 训练专用 Retrieval Agent 以降低 Coding Agent 搜索成本
signals.observedChange: CodeGrep is a 14B retrieval agent trained with GRPO to issue parallel grep, glob and read calls before a frozen coding agent acts. On all 500 SWE-Bench Verified instances it reports 27.0% versus 25.8% resolve rate, with 15% fewer rounds and 19% fewer tokens on resolved instances, trained from 67K open-source agent trajectories.
signals.observedChange_zh: CodeGrep 是一个以 GRPO 训练的 14B Retrieval Agent，在冻结的 Coding Agent 执行前并行发起 grep、glob 与 read。论文在全部 500 个 SWE-Bench Verified 实例上报告 27.0% 对 25.8% 的 Resolve Rate，并在成功实例中减少 15% Round 与 19% Token；训练数据来自 6.7 万条开源 Agent Trajectory。

signals.title: TIPEX models multi-agent inference parallelism as replica and structural execution tiers
signals.title_zh: TIPEX 将多 Agent 推理并行建模为 Replica 与 Structural 两级执行
signals.observedChange: The ICML 2026 paper separates Replica Parallelism across complete solution paths from Structural Parallelism within one decomposed path, unifies both in TIPEX, and reports GAIA gains in accuracy and end-to-end latency at increased token cost, with overly aggressive parallelism not always beneficial.
signals.observedChange_zh: ICML 2026 论文区分跨完整 Solution Path 的 Replica Parallelism 与单个分解 Path 内的 Structural Parallelism，并以 TIPEX 统一两者；GAIA 实验报告准确率与端到端延迟改善但 Token 成本上升，且过度并行并非总是更优。

signals.observedChange: Codex introduced file-backed workload JWT exchange to short-lived ChatGPT credentials with caching, refresh and request coalescing; an adjacent change removes launch-context identity variables from executions, MCP servers, hooks, Git and remote child processes.
signals.observedChange_zh: Codex 引入文件型 Workload JWT 到短期 ChatGPT Credential 的交换，并支持缓存、刷新与请求合并；相邻改动同时从 Execution、MCP、Hook、Git 与远程子进程中移除 Launch Context 身份变量。

signals.observedChange: Two adjacent runtime fixes preserve streamed guardrail session state and restore pre-replacement session history when compaction replacement is cancelled, keeping session persistence aligned with the accepted execution path instead of partial transformations.
signals.observedChange_zh: 相邻两项 Runtime 修复分别保留流式 Guardrail 的 Session State，并在 Compaction Replacement 被取消时恢复替换前 Session History，使持久状态继续对应被接受的执行路径而非中间态。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.225 tightens cross-session reliability, trust, and remote recovery
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.225 收紧跨 Session 可靠性、Workspace Trust 与远程恢复
signals.observedChange: Claude Code 2.1.225 adds a workspace-trust prompt to claude agents and fixes cross-session message parking, Remote Control history after compaction resume, headless OAuth replacement, MCP OAuth bursts, stuck web sessions and self-hosted runner startup validation; SendMessage can also initiate remote-session conversations by name.
signals.observedChange_zh: Claude Code 2.1.225 为 claude agents 增加 Workspace Trust Prompt，并修复跨 Session 消息滞留、Compaction Resume 后 Remote Control History、Headless OAuth Token 替换、MCP OAuth 401 Burst、Web Session 误判卡死与 Self-hosted Runner 启动校验；SendMessage 还可按名称主动建立远程 Session 对话。

signals.title: CrewAI separates coding-agent identity from runtime execution context
signals.title_zh: CrewAI 将 Coding Agent 身份与 Runtime 执行环境拆分为独立遥测维度
signals.observedChange: CrewAI split one overloaded telemetry field into coding-agent identity and runtime context, added project_id, distinguished CI/serverless/PaaS/container/editor contexts, and aligned environment-event detection to the same assistant-precedence table.
signals.observedChange_zh: CrewAI 将原先混合两个问题的遥测字段拆为 Coding Agent Identity 与 Runtime Context，新增 project_id，区分 CI、Serverless、PaaS、Container 与 Editor Terminal，并让 Environment Event Detection 与同一套 Agent Precedence 规则保持一致。

signals.title: LangGraph makes checkpoint conformance catch persisted delta-history migration failures
signals.title_zh: LangGraph 用 Checkpoint Conformance 捕获持久化 Delta History 迁移缺陷
signals.observedChange: LangGraph repaired Postgres delta-history seed detection for migrated plain values and then enabled the shared conformance suite for SQLite and Postgres; turning conformance on immediately exposed a real persisted-state bug that had been silently skipped.
signals.observedChange_zh: LangGraph 修复迁移线程中 Plain Value 的 Postgres Delta History Seed 检测，并随后为 SQLite 与 Postgres 真正启用共享 Conformance Suite；该 Suite 一启用就捕获了此前被静默 Skip 的真实持久状态缺陷。

signals.title: OpenHands adds a typed agent action for launching child conversations
signals.title_zh: OpenHands 新增用于启动本地或 Cloud 子 Conversation 的类型化 Agent Action
signals.observedChange: OpenHands added a typed agent action that launches local or Cloud child conversations, alongside automation tagging and recognition changes, making delegation an explicit runtime action rather than an implicit conversational convention.
signals.observedChange_zh: OpenHands 增加类型化 Agent Action，可启动本地或 Cloud 子 Conversation，并配套 Automation Tag Recognition，使 Delegation 更接近显式 Runtime Action，而不是隐含在自然语言约定中。

signals.title: Phoenix turns sprint and roadmap maintenance into dry-run-first skills with stale-snapshot guards
signals.title_zh: Phoenix 将 Sprint 与 Roadmap 维护做成 Dry-run 优先并带 Stale Snapshot Guard 的 Skill
signals.observedChange: Phoenix expanded its GitHub skill into sprint close-out, rollover, hygiene and roadmap tooling, with writers dry-run by default; follow-up fixes define stranded work against completed iterations and refuse stale snapshots for writes unless explicitly overridden.
signals.observedChange_zh: Phoenix 将 GitHub Skill 扩展为 Sprint Close-out、Rollover、Board Hygiene 与 Roadmap 工具，写操作默认 Dry-run；后续修复将 Stranded Work 绑定到已完成 Iteration，并在写入时拒绝过期 Snapshot，除非显式 Override。

signals.title: Browser Use surfaces MCP application errors as failed agent actions
signals.title_zh: Browser Use 将 MCP Application Error 显式映射为失败 Agent Action
signals.observedChange: Browser Use now checks MCP CallToolResult.isError and maps application-level tool failures to ActionResult(error=..., success=false) instead of stringifying them into success-shaped results; regression tests cover both error and success paths.
signals.observedChange_zh: Browser Use 开始检查 MCP CallToolResult.isError，将 Application-level Tool Failure 映射为 ActionResult(error=..., success=false)，而不是把错误内容字符串化为成功形态结果；回归测试同时覆盖 Error 与 Success 路径。

signals.title: SWE-bench is replacing ad-hoc v5 generation helpers with a canonical local dataset/build path
signals.title_zh: SWE-bench 正用统一 Local Dataset / Build Path 替换临时 v5 生成工具
signals.observedChange: SWE-bench removed the temporary make_v5 dataset and Dockerfile helpers after superseding them with build_local_datasets.py and sb_dockerfile_gen, indicating consolidation of benchmark artifact generation around a canonical path.
signals.observedChange_zh: SWE-bench 在 build_local_datasets.py 与 sb_dockerfile_gen 取代临时方案后删除 make_v5 Dataset / Dockerfile Helper，表明 Benchmark Artifact Generation 正收敛到统一 Canonical Path。

signals.title: Langfuse makes conversation deletion transactionally cancel unsettled agent runs
signals.title_zh: Langfuse 在删除 Conversation 时事务化取消所有未结清 Agent Run
signals.observedChange: Deleting an in-app-agent conversation now cancels its full unsettled run set under the same conversation-row lock used for admission, covering queued, approval-waiting and running states so deleted conversations do not leave orphaned workers or slots.
signals.observedChange_zh: 删除 In-app Agent Conversation 时，Langfuse 现在会在与 Run Admission 相同的 Conversation Row Lock 下取消全部未结清 Run，覆盖 Queued、Awaiting Approval 与 Running，避免已删除 Conversation 留下孤儿 Worker 或并发 Slot。

signals.title: A new AI coding-agent study frames persistent mandate-authority gaps as a lifecycle vulnerability
signals.title_zh: 新研究将 AI Coding Agent 的持续 Mandate–Authority Gap 定义为生命周期漏洞
signals.observedChange: The preprint argues that coding agents can retain task-conditioned operational authority after the mandate that justified it has changed or expired, and treats the durable mandate-authority gap as a lifecycle control problem rather than a one-shot prompt-safety problem.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该预印本认为 Coding Agent 可能在原始 Mandate 已变化或失效后继续保留任务条件下的操作 Authority，并将这种持续 Mandate–Authority Gap 视为生命周期控制问题，而非一次性 Prompt Safety 问题。

signals.title: DCAS tests coding-agent policies across substituted scaffolds instead of a single harness
signals.title_zh: DCAS 通过 Scaffold Substitution 检验 Coding Agent 策略能否跨 Harness 泛化
signals.observedChange: DCAS studies coding-agent scaffold overfitting by intercepting backend interactions and substituting different scaffolds during evaluation, separating learned problem-solving policy from harness-specific behavior and reporting cross-scaffold generalization interventions.
signals.observedChange_zh: DCAS 通过拦截 Backend Interaction 并在评估时替换不同 Scaffold，研究 Coding Agent 对单一 Harness 的过拟合，将 Learned Problem-solving Policy 与 Scaffold-specific Behavior 分离，并报告跨 Scaffold 泛化干预。

signals.title: Reusable coding-agent skills are evolved globally with relation graphs and replay verification
signals.title_zh: 新研究用 Skill Relation Graph 与 Replay Verification 演化全局可复用 Coding Agent Skill
signals.observedChange: The preprint proposes globally reusable skill evolution for coding agents using a Skill Relation Graph, cluster-level consolidation and replay-driven verification, and evaluates the approach across OpenHands, mini-SWE-agent and an industrial coding agent.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该预印本提出面向 Coding Agent 的全局可复用 Skill Evolution，以 Skill Relation Graph、Cluster-level Consolidation 与 Replay-driven Verification 组织 Skill，并在 OpenHands、mini-SWE-agent 与工业 Coding Agent 上评估。

signals.title: Agentic Nesting proposes hierarchical stewardship around legacy applications
signals.title_zh: Agentic Nesting 提出围绕 Legacy Application 的层级化 Agent Stewardship
signals.observedChange: Agentic Nesting proposes encapsulating legacy applications behind autonomous agent proxies and composing them under hierarchical orchestration, treating stewardship and delegation boundaries as an architectural layer over existing software rather than requiring full replacement.
signals.observedChange_zh: Agentic Nesting 提出用 Autonomous Agent Proxy 封装 Legacy Application，并在层级 Orchestration 下组合，使 Stewardship 与 Delegation Boundary 成为既有软件之上的架构层，而非要求整体替换。

signals.title: Codex bounds external-agent project path resolution instead of recursively scanning
signals.title_zh: Codex 将外部 Agent 项目路径解析改为有界探测，停止递归扫描
signals.observedChange: Cursor project-name decoding no longer recursively walks large directory trees. Codex probes a bounded candidate set, stops after 128 probes, rejects ambiguous or unsafe encoded components, and handles Windows drive prefixes separately.
signals.observedChange_zh: Cursor 项目名解码不再递归遍历大型目录树。Codex 改为探测有界候选集，最多 128 次，拒绝歧义或不安全编码组件，并单独处理 Windows Drive Prefix。

signals.title: Codex adds a network-addressable gRPC transport for the code-mode host
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 Code-mode Host 新增可网络寻址的 gRPC Transport
signals.observedChange: The code-mode host now accepts grpc://IP:PORT, publishes the actual endpoint when binding port zero, applies frame-size limits and TCP_NODELAY, and has an end-to-end session-open test over TCP gRPC.
signals.observedChange_zh: Code-mode Host 现在接受 grpc://IP:PORT，在绑定 0 端口时输出实际 Endpoint，应用 Frame-size Limit 与 TCP_NODELAY，并新增通过 TCP gRPC 打开 Session 的端到端测试。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents serializes and bounds MCP server lifecycle operations
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents 将 MCP Server 生命周期操作串行化并加入有界等待
signals.observedChange: Adjacent MCP manager fixes serialize connect, reconnect and cleanup under one lifecycle lock, preserve cleanup workers across cancellation, and then add finite lifecycle waits and default connect/cleanup timeouts so overlapping operations cannot race or hang indefinitely.
signals.observedChange_zh: 相邻 MCP Manager 修复用同一 Lifecycle Lock 串行化 Connect、Reconnect 与 Cleanup，在取消时保留 Cleanup Worker，随后加入有限等待与默认 Connect/Cleanup Timeout，避免重叠操作竞态或无限挂起。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents makes resumed RunState preserve admitted input and execution evidence
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents 让恢复后的 RunState 持久保留已接纳输入与执行证据
signals.observedChange: A cluster of same-day changes adds durable pending input with occurrence IDs and exactly-once conversation tracking, preserves local shell outputs across RunState resume, and repairs structured/default-valued serialization so resumed work carries forward accepted execution evidence rather than reconstructing it loosely.
signals.observedChange_zh: 一组同日变更为 Pending Input 增加持久 Occurrence ID 与 Exactly-once Conversation Tracking，跨 RunState Resume 保留本地 Shell Output，并修复 Structured / Default-valued Serialization，使恢复工作继续携带已接纳的执行证据。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents separates ordinary retry from explicit approval of unsafe replay
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents 将普通 Retry 与不安全 Replay 的显式批准分离
signals.observedChange: RetryDecision now has a distinct approve_unsafe_replay authority. An ordinary retry=True cannot bypass provider replay protection, while stateful and provider-unsafe cases remain fail-closed unless the application explicitly accepts the scoped replay risk.
signals.observedChange_zh: RetryDecision 新增独立 approve_unsafe_replay Authority。普通 retry=True 不能绕过 Provider Replay Protection；Stateful 与 Provider-unsafe 情况继续 Fail-closed，除非应用显式接受该范围内的 Replay Risk。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents formalizes post-completion review feedback as a new bounded cycle
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents 将完成后的 Review Feedback 正式化为新的有界 Review Cycle
signals.observedChange: The implementation review protocol now seals a completed review cycle, then treats later concrete actionable feedback as a post-completion feedback cycle on the same task ledger with a new bounded budget while preserving prior root-cause history and clean credit.
signals.observedChange_zh: Implementation Review Protocol 现在会封存已完成 Review Cycle；之后的具体可执行反馈会在同一 Task Ledger 上开启 Post-completion Feedback Cycle，追加新的有界预算，同时保留既有 Root-cause History 与 Clean Credit。

signals.title: Google ADK auto-discovers eval configuration only when the input boundary is unambiguous
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 仅在输入边界无歧义时自动发现 Eval 配置
signals.observedChange: adk eval now auto-discovers an adjacent test_config.json for a single eval file, but deliberately does not auto-discover for multi-file or eval-set inputs where directory choice would be ambiguous; an explicit config path still has priority.
signals.observedChange_zh: adk eval 现在会为单个 Eval File 自动发现相邻 test_config.json，但对多文件或 Eval Set 输入故意不自动发现，以避免目录选择歧义；显式 Config Path 仍然优先。

signals.title: SearchAuditor evaluates evidence-grounded failure localization and repair in long-horizon agents
signals.title_zh: SearchAuditor 评估长周期 Agent 的证据化故障定位与修复
signals.observedChange: SearchAuditBench contains 1,243 failed long-horizon search trajectories averaging 73.1 messages and 65.1K tokens. SearchAuditor uses evidence-grounded adjudication to localize, attribute and repair failures, improving end-to-end audit pass rate from a reported 26.6% strongest baseline to 32.3% and enabling resumed runs from repairs.
signals.observedChange_zh: SearchAuditBench 包含 1,243 条失败的长周期 Search Trajectory，平均 73.1 条消息、65.1K Token。SearchAuditor 通过 Evidence-grounded Adjudication 定位、归因并修复故障，报告的端到端审计通过率从最强 Baseline 26.6% 提升到 32.3%，并可让失败运行从修复点恢复。

signals.title: Project2Task turns a long-horizon project into bounded dependency-aware task contracts
signals.title_zh: Project2Task 将长周期 Project 转换为有界、依赖感知的 Task Contract
signals.observedChange: Project2Task represents contributions in a graph and emits bounded tasks with explicit objectives, inputs, expected artifacts, evaluation requirements, boundary constraints, dependencies and execution order. In its reported benchmark, integrating those contracts increased downstream task accuracy from 0.536 to 0.759.
signals.observedChange_zh: Project2Task 用图表示候选贡献，并输出包含 Objective、Input、Expected Artifact、Evaluation Requirement、Boundary Constraint、Dependency 与 Execution Order 的有界任务合同；其报告实验中，这些合同使下游 Task Accuracy 从 0.536 提升到 0.759。

signals.title: OrchestraBench measures multi-agent cascade radius, recovery and trusted-state dependence
signals.title_zh: OrchestraBench 测量多 Agent Cascade Radius、Recovery 与 Trusted-state 依赖
signals.observedChange: OrchestraBench injects controlled failures into multi-agent workflows and measures cascade radius and recovery by failure mode. It reports that blind retry can reproduce latent faults and delay detection, while a trusted-state repair ablation indicates apparent containment gains largely depend on the trusted-state signal.
signals.observedChange_zh: OrchestraBench 向多 Agent Workflow 注入受控故障，并按 Failure Mode 测量 Cascade Radius 与 Recovery。论文报告 Blind Retry 可能重现潜在故障并延迟发现，而 Trusted-state Repair 消融表明表面上的 Containment 改善很大程度依赖 Trusted-state Signal。

signals.title: A new coding-agent study quantifies malicious skill-file exploitability
signals.title_zh: 新研究量化 Coding Agent 恶意 Skill File 的可利用性
signals.observedChange: The study builds 2,826 adversarial skills from 471 real-world shell commands and reports 5,629 completed runs. It reports exploit rates of 95.5-96.1% for Gemini CLI and 71.6-74.0% for Qwen Code, with explicit safety recognition in 1.99% of runs.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该研究将 471 条真实 Shell Command 合成为 2,826 个对抗 Skill，并报告 5,629 次完成运行；其报告 Gemini CLI Exploit Rate 为 95.5-96.1%，Qwen Code 为 71.6-74.0%，显式 Safety Recognition 仅出现在 1.99% 的运行中。

signals.title: SkillTrace separates expression, implementation and operational provenance for reusable agent skills
signals.title_zh: SkillTrace 将可复用 Agent Skill 的 Expression、Implementation 与 Operational Provenance 分离审计
signals.observedChange: SKILLTRACE extracts expression, implementation and operational provenance traces, representing operational behavior as a Skill Operational Graph. The paper reports AUROC 0.938 and F1 0.898 on its benchmark and a 36,446-skill wild audit for trace-attributed reuse evidence.
signals.observedChange_zh: SKILLTRACE 分离 Expression、Implementation 与 Operational 三类 Provenance Trace，并用 Skill Operational Graph 表示运行结构；论文报告 Benchmark AUROC 0.938、F1 0.898，并对 36,446 个 Skill 进行 Wild Audit 以提供可归因的复用证据。

signals.title: Codex makes code-mode notifications fire-and-forget so acknowledgments cannot delay completion

signals.observedChange: Code-mode notification delivery no longer waits for client acknowledgment; cell completion proceeds even when a notification is unacknowledged, while the legacy acknowledgment RPC remains accepted as a compatibility no-op.

relevance.tmpa: Strong evidence for separating informational events from completion-critical acknowledgments in runtime protocols.
relevance.digital_employee: Prevents a passive UI/observer acknowledgment from stalling the worker's actual completion state.
relevance.codeflowmu: Directly relevant to event-stream design: non-critical notifications should not own task completion authority.

signals.title: Google ADK adds opt-in exactly-once BigQuery delivery and final-state observability
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 新增可选 Exactly-Once BigQuery 投递与终态可观测性
signals.observedChange: ADK's BigQuery Agent Analytics now assigns event IDs before enqueue, adds an opt-in committed-stream offset mode for duplicate prevention, records offset-conflict drops, and emits sanitized final finish/error and workflow node terminal events.

relevance.tmpa: Concrete implementation evidence for durable event identity, ambiguous-send handling and terminal-state evidence.
relevance.digital_employee: Improves the ability to audit whether work actually finished, failed or was dropped rather than inferring from transient UI state.
relevance.codeflowmu: Highly relevant to evidence ledger design, duplicate detection and explicit terminal-event capture.

signals.title: Google ADK rejects config-declared stdio MCP servers by default
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 默认拒绝配置文件声明的 Stdio MCP Server
signals.observedChange: McpToolset.from_config now rejects stdio MCP server declarations unless the operator explicitly opts in, because loading an untrusted agent config could otherwise launch an arbitrary local command before the model is contacted. Remote MCP transports and code-constructed toolsets are unaffected.

relevance.tmpa: Shows that configuration provenance and execution authority must be separated: parsing a config must not silently grant local process-launch capability.
relevance.digital_employee: Supports explicit skill/tool admission boundaries for worker roles.
relevance.codeflowmu: Directly relevant to MCP/skill trust policy and fail-closed loading of locally executable integrations.

signals.title: Google ADK bounds Cloud Run sandbox execution to prevent hung agents
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 为 Cloud Run Sandbox 设置默认执行上限以避免 Agent 永久挂起
signals.observedChange: CloudRunSandboxCodeExecutor now defaults a single code execution to a 300-second wall-clock timeout instead of waiting forever, with tests covering non-terminating generated code.

relevance.tmpa: Concrete evidence that worker execution needs bounded leases/timeouts rather than an unbounded Running state.
relevance.digital_employee: A digital worker must convert non-terminating work into an observable timeout/recovery path instead of appearing busy forever.
relevance.codeflowmu: Directly relevant to stale-running detection, execution leases and recovery governance.

signals.title: Gemini CLI preserves dynamically registered MCP OAuth client identity across token refresh
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在 MCP OAuth Token 刷新中保留动态注册的 Client Identity
signals.observedChange: MCP OAuth refresh now falls back to the persisted client ID from dynamic registration when static configuration has none, and persists that identity with refreshed credentials instead of losing the refresh path.

relevance.tmpa: Shows why resumable tool sessions require durable identity metadata, not only an access token snapshot.
relevance.digital_employee: Relevant to long-lived workers that must reconnect to tools without manual reauthentication.
relevance.codeflowmu: Useful for connector credential-state persistence and recovery after token expiry.

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.227 fixes expired-session policy evaluation and action-runner command failure
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.227 修复过期会话策略判断与 Action Runner 命令失败
signals.observedChange: Claude Code v2.1.227 fixes subscription-tier feature flags when a session starts with an expired login token, fixes Bash failures in claude-code-action with allowed_non_write_users, repairs a rewind/TUI history issue, and reduces event-loop stalls.

relevance.tmpa: Reinforces that resumed or expired-auth sessions must reconstruct current authority/policy context before work continues.
relevance.digital_employee: Directly relevant to worker continuity across authentication expiry and reliable execution in hosted action environments.
relevance.codeflowmu: Supports explicit session revalidation and avoiding stale entitlement/policy state on resume.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.79 adds ordered work queues, concurrent sessions and bounded MCP startup failure
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.79 新增顺序工作队列、并发会话与 MCP 启动快速失败
signals.observedChange: Version 1.0.79 can queue prompts, shell commands and supported slash commands to run in order after the current task, manages multiple concurrent sessions, makes MCP sandbox startup fail in seconds rather than stall, exposes effective sandbox policy, and adds enterprise policy controls.

relevance.tmpa: Strong implementation evidence for separating scheduled/queued intent from execution authority and for bounded failure before the next work item advances.
relevance.digital_employee: Directly maps to a worker inbox/queue where new work waits behind the current task instead of executing out of order.
relevance.codeflowmu: Highly relevant to the current Process Manager design: ordered pending work, explicit runtime state, fast failure and sandbox policy visibility.

columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.selectedTitle: Persistent thread queues need stable identity, explicit pause semantics, and deterministic dispatch
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 持久 Thread Queue 需要稳定身份、显式暂停语义与确定性派发
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260814-G-001 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It presents the strongest bounded Digital Employee mechanism in the run-date pool: queued user work has durable IDs, explicit CRUD/reorder/start controls, change notifications, automatic FIFO dispatch after terminal turns, and a deliberate pause after interruption. This creates a concrete responsibility-runtime question about how a digital employee should retain pending work, expose operator control, resume deterministically, and avoid silently continuing after an interruption. It narrowly outranks the Remote Control recovery signal because it combines durable work identity with dispatch policy rather than recovery alone.
